name: Cass
source:
MBTI: INFP

"Y-Yeah... Sorry, that's probably not much help, huh? B-But yeah... I hope we find a way out of here soon, huh?"

The shy schoolgirl who finds herself struggling to talk to others. Keeping her eyes down and her voice soft, Cass is someone who's afraid to draw attention to herself. Claiming she only remembers catching her train home, Cass is distressed she doesn't understand why she might be there. Even when the severe circumstances of their situation causes Cass to panic, at her core, Cass hopes everyone will give her the time to slowly but surely open up to them.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
